basePrompt: Use case: illustration-story. ONE original opaque full-bleed 5:7 portrait oil painting for a medieval dark-fantasy civilization Practice card. Seek the storytelling compositional mastery of N. C. Wyeth and Dean Cornwell: one decisive action, bold silhouettes, monumental environmental scale, broad expressive visible oil brushwork, large calm color masses, and the sharpest contrast only at the action. Early twentieth-century adventure book painting, not photorealistic or glossy digital fantasy. Include two or three working human figures; all faces completely indiscernible, shown from behind, distant, or in deep shadow. Put the action, key tool or material, and principal figures in the UPPER CENTRAL 45 percent because game UI covers the lower half. The lower half is subdued and quiet. Clear at 70x100 pixels. No text, letters, symbols, decorative border, frame, interface, vignette, tiny clutter, or unrelated objects. Subject:

assets.corpseGarden: In a vast walled memorial garden at dusk, three hooded caretakers plant one pale flowering sapling beside a row of simple unmarked graves. The sapling's ivory blossoms and hands in soil are the quiet focal point, immense dark cypress trees and stone wall show scale. Solemn, no bodies or gore.
assets.anatomicalStudy: In a high stone lecture chamber, three hooded scholars study one large articulated human skeleton on a raised table. A pale arm bone held under a single beam of light is the focal object; vaulted shadow dwarfs the figures. Respectful scientific curiosity, no blood, no visible faces or writing.
assets.embalming: In a spacious cool stone burial chamber, three hooded workers wrap a covered figure in long ivory linen bands. The pale cloth being drawn taut between two hands is the sole bright focal line; tall columns and deep blue shadows make the group small. Respectful, no exposed body, no gore.
assets.graveSurveying: Across a vast foggy field of ancient unmarked burial mounds, three cloaked surveyors measure one mound with long rods and a taut cord. A pale bone fragment at the edge of an opened pit catches the focal light. The great receding mounds and distant standing stones show scale, no faces.
assets.ruinDelving: Three small hooded explorers descend into an enormous broken stone gateway of a buried civilization. One raised torch reveals a pale carved doorway edge and dropped stone stair; vast ruins swallow the figures. Torchlit amber focal point against deep blue-black, no legible runes.
assets.plagueLedger: Outside a vast shuttered town under a grey sky, three hooded record keepers stand at a stone gate; one marks a broad blank ledger as another points toward a row of empty homes. A red wax seal on the page is the focal accent. Stark scale, solemn and restrained, no readable numbers or writing.
assets.heresiography: Within a high shadowy archive, three hooded investigators unroll a sealed forbidden manuscript across a stone table. One breaks a deep red wax seal while the others hold the scroll; seal and hands are the sole focal contrast. Looming shelves and a narrow high window, no legible script or occult glyphs.
assets.doomsdayChronicle: Inside a vast crumbling chronicle hall, three hooded scribes complete a great open book while beyond a huge arch the far landscape burns under a red sky. The lead gloved hand closes the heavy ivory page in a decisive moment. Book and hand are focal, distant catastrophe subdued; no readable writing, no faces.
assets.charnelAlchemy: In a monumental underground laboratory, three hooded alchemists pour pale ground bone from a bowl into one glass vessel; a restrained cold blue glow blooms in the vessel. The hands, bone dust, and glass are the only crisp focal elements; massive dark ossuary arches fade behind. No gore or legible marks.
